column3: The mountain beyond Goma\nhas stopped burning.{page_break}Quiet again. For now.\nI don't trust it.{end_wait}
The curse is broken, so\nwhy not build the palace\nafter all?{end_wait}
That's it! It's over!\nMilord won't build the\npalace after all.{end_wait}

Hmph! My palace isn't
finished!{page_break}He loves that wretched
tree more than he loves
me!{end_wait}
I never want to be a tree\nagain. I felt everything.\nIt was terrible.{end_wait}
Few lumberjacks will cut\nin Kolima Forest now.\nCan you blame them?{end_wait}
Two others came later.\nOne of them looked hurt.{end_wait}
Stay away from that one.\nHe might turn to wood\nagain.{end_wait}
Lord McCoy and his wife\nare fighting again.\nPlace your bets.{end_wait}
Anyone could walk right\nthrough that barricade.\nSome good it did us.{end_wait}
\"The Gang of Three\"{em_dash}HA!\nThey're probably asleep\nin a ditch somewhere.{end_wait}
McCoy will reward you\nwell, I'm sure. I wonder\nwhat it'll be.{end_wait}
They're surely telling\nLord McCoy what you did\nright now.{end_wait}
I'm so relieved I could\ncry. Let me share it\nwith you!{end_wait}
As long as I'm fine, I\ndon't care what happens\nto anyone else.{end_wait}

We'd still be working if
they hadn't used the holy
tree for the palace.{page_break}I told them not to.
No one listened.{end_wait}
That was close!{page_break}Building a cursed palace\nwould ruin my name.{end_wait}

He says he stopped it so
I wouldn't be cursed...{page_break}I think he's just
weaseling out of his
promise!{end_wait}
Did the holy tree\nsurvive? Do you know?{end_now}
Thank goodness the palace\nwas called off.{page_break}Lady McCoy took it\nbadly, though.{end_wait}

A tree takes centuries to
grow that old.{page_break}No man has the right
to kill something so
precious.{end_wait}
Sometimes I wonder what\nthe palace would've\nlooked like.{end_wait}
I miss Altin in winter.{page_break}I worked the mines\nthere. It was always\nwarm down below.{end_wait}
My father says it's warm\nall year past the river.{end_wait}
I wonder if there are\nstill gems in Altin Mine.{end_wait}
My father has traveled\nthe whole world.{end_wait}
The Kolima road is open\nagain. You can go on\nyour way.{end_wait}
The road makes young\nwarriors stronger.\nOr buries them.{end_wait}
I saw lights in the sky\nover Imil last night.{page_break}Could the lighthouse\nhave been the source?{end_wait}
His eyes are red\nbecause he didn't sleep.{end_wait}
There's no doubt. That's\nthe light from the Imil\nlighthouse.{end_wait}
What's the big deal? It's\njust a lighthouse.{end_wait}

The ocean fills me with
hope, somehow. And hunger.{page_break}If you see it, think of
men like me who only
dream of it.{end_wait}
I wish I could sail out\nonto the ocean...{page_break}But I don't have the\ncourage.{end_wait}
Every warrior McCoy hired\nturned out useless.{page_break}Except the young ones\nwho broke the curse.{end_wait}
They call themselves\nwarriors...{page_break}but when it matters,\nthey run.{end_wait}
That curse in Kolima.\nHorrifying, wasn't it?{end_now}

Fewer guests now that
it's over.{page_break}Whoever ended the curse
didn't do our business
any favors.{end_wait}

No business here, so I'm
going south of the river
to Xian.{page_break}Maybe I'll take the Silk
Road as far as Tolbi.{end_wait}
It was over before I\nknew it...{page_break}Maybe I'll cross the\nriver and look for work.{end_wait}

That eerie howling from
south of the river...{page_break}I couldn't sleep. It
sounded almost like a
woman screaming.{end_wait}
Terrible things are\nhappening all over the\nworld lately.{end_wait}

Things look grim south
of the Goma Range.
Black clouds are coming.{page_break}If you're headed that
way, be ready for rain.{end_wait}

They crossed the river
after shoving us down.{page_break}It's monstrous!
How could anyone do
that?{end_wait}

Rotten luck, being
turned to trees right
then.{page_break}We only wanted to pick
persimmons. Who knew?{end_wait}
